title: Prachyam Indiclass
desc: I designed an opening identity for Prachyam’s Indiclass series.
lead: I developed the opening identity and motion-design styleframes for Prachyam’s Indiclass series.
body: I explored logo directions and developed the title treatment for Indiclass, Prachyam’s series on Indian culture and knowledge. The styleframes bring together cultural imagery and light as a symbol of learning.
detail: My work spans logo exploration, the final title design, styleframes and motion direction for the series opening.
contribution: Led the visual direction, from logo exploration to the final title treatment.
Created styleframes using Indian art, cultural imagery and light as a symbol of knowledge.
Developed the motion direction for the opening identity.
summary: I developed the opening identity and motion-design styleframes for Prachyam’s Indiclass series.
